differences.a_observable: The shadow cast by the yellow Recurly button is soft and diffused.
differences.b_observable: The shadow cast by the yellow Recurly button is extremely dark and hard-edged.
differences.fix: Increase the size of the light source or adjust shadow blur settings to soften the shadow edges.

differences.a_observable: The background elements, such as the Revenue Analytics card, are heavily blurred by depth of field.
differences.b_observable: The background elements are sharp and in focus, with no noticeable depth of field blur.
differences.fix: Enable depth of field on the camera and adjust the aperture to blur background elements.

differences.a_observable: The yellow button has a warm, golden-yellow hue.
differences.b_observable: The yellow button has a highly saturated, bright lemon-yellow color.
differences.fix: Modify the diffuse color of the yellow button material to be warmer and less saturated.

differences.a_observable: The Subscriptions card is positioned on the left side of the frame, partially cut off.
differences.b_observable: The Subscriptions card is positioned near the bottom-left corner of the frame.
differences.fix: Adjust the layout and spacing of the cards on the grid to match the reference composition.

json.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the camera's depth of field to introduce realistic background blur, and soften the hard-edged shadows cast by the 3D elements.
